This '''clone navigation officer''' was stationed on the bridge of the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and served under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] began their attack, this [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|Clone naval officer]] informed Admiral Yularen that the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] were pressing their attack and he was told to contact command at [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].
